requirement.en: Process analogValues in batches into engineering values. count is how many channels to process; match channels by ordinal position from each array's lower bound. Per channel, if enabled convert by measuringMode (0 linear 0/+-27648 to loLIM..hiLIM; 1 standard temperature =raw/10; 2 climatic temperature =raw/100). Invalid mode sets retVal 16#8001; hiLIM<=loLIM sets retVal 16#8002.
requirement.zh: 批量把模拟量原始值 analogValues 转换为工程量。count 为要处理的通道数，按各自数组下界对齐通道。每通道若 enable 则按 measuringMode 转换：0 线性(单极性 0..27648、双极性 -27648..27648 映射到 loLIM..hiLIM)、1 标准温度(原值/10)、2 气候温度(原值/100)。模式非法置 retVal 16#8001；hiLIM<=loLIM 置 retVal 16#8002。
